articles.title: SHARx Advocates For Outcome-Driven PBM Reform Over Superficial Headlines
articles.summary: SHARx emphasizes that current pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) reform efforts must be evaluated based on tangible financial outcomes for self-funded employers rather than legislative or media headlines. This perspective matters because employers need true cost containment and transparency rather than symbolic policy changes in the pharmacy benefits space. Key business implications include encouraging self-funded plan sponsors to look beyond surface-level PBM contract changes and demand verifiable cost-saving results from their vendor partnerships.
